newsitem.title: USA: MicroEnergy expects revenue gain in FY97.
newsitem.headline: MicroEnergy expects revenue gain in FY97.

text.p: MicroEnergy Inc said Thursday it expects to realize revenue growth of about 18 to 25 percent during fiscal 1997.
For the year ended June 30, 1996, the company posted revenues of $14.4 million.
In a statement, president Robert Gatza said the company's July public offering raised $2.7 million in net proceeds.

"Other positive developments include a new banking relationship which provides a revolving line of credit up to $3 million," he added. "We also refinanced several of our existing loans. All of this should lower our interest expense and add to the bottom line."
